title: Chess: check, checkmate, stalemate detection
description: is_in_check(player): is player's king attacked by any opponent piece? Legal move filtering: a move is legal only if it does not leave own king in check. Checkmate: in check + no legal moves. Stalemate: not in check + no legal moves. All move generation must filter through check validation.
close_reason: is_attacked, in_check, legal_moves (filtered through check), checkmate, stalemate. 12 tests.
